verdicts.evidence: Sympy symbolic substitution of T_c=T^α, Ψ(T_c)=√(1+T_c(1+T_c)), γ_T=Õ(1), β'_T=Õ(1) into the stated bound yields growth exponent e(α)=2α+1/2, giving sublinearity exactly at α<1/4; this matches the paper's intermediate form R_T=Õ(T_c²√T) and all 8 Matérn Table 1 entries for FC reproduce to grid resolution. Mutation test removing Ψ shifts threshold to α<1/2, confirming the bound's tightness comes from the observability penalty.

Sympy substitution into R_T=Õ((1+T_c Ψ(T_c)²)√(β'_T T(γ_T+T_c))) yields exponent e(α)=7α/2+1/2, giving sublinearity exactly at α<1/7≈0.1429; matches the paper's intermediate form R_T=Õ(T_c^{7/2}√T) and all 8 Matérn Table 1 entries for A2. Mutation test removing Ψ shifts threshold to α<1/3, matching the paper's Ideal column.

Exhaustive enumeration over 1040 configurations (10 seeds × 8 corrupted indices × 13 magnitudes up to 10¹²) shows RCGP posterior mean deviation from the uncorrupted posterior remains bounded at 1.4212 and converges as |c|→∞ (drift 9.93e-7 between 10⁶ and 10¹²), while standard GP deviation reaches 4.983e+11 and scales linearly with |c|. Mutation test disabling the P-IMQ weight makes RCGP deviation unbounded (4.536e+11), confirming the mechanism.

Symbolically Ψ(0)=1.0 and both Theorem 4.2 and 4.3 bounds collapse exactly to O(√(Tβ'_Tγ_T)). Numerically, on the uncorrupted Forrester benchmark (5 init points, 30 iterations, 10 seeds, L=10), FC-RCGP-UCB and A2-RCGP-UCB produce bit-identical queries and cumulative regret to GP-UCB (max difference 0.0, mean regret 34.9909 for all three). Mutation test violating the plateau condition (L=0.05) causes divergence on 10/10 seeds.

Real runs on 1-D Forrester with 10 seeds produce actual regret numbers showing RCGP methods rank below GP-UCB, Student-t, and DiagnosticsGP under one endorsed configuration, but the setup uses proxy components (fixed RBF hyperparameters instead of LOO-CV, grid argmax, own DiagnosticsGP), the advantage over GP-UCB is within one standard error (11.4%/5.8%), and the ordering flips under another paper-endorsed configuration (adaptive T_c estimate) where RCGP methods become worse than most baselines.

overall: The logbook provides rigorous symbolic verification of the theoretical regret bounds and their α-thresholds (Claims 1–2), concrete numerical evidence that the RCGP mechanism bounds posterior deviation under arbitrarily large corruptions while GP does not (Claim 3), and both symbolic and bit-identical numeric confirmation of zero-cost robustness at T_c=0 (Claim 4). The experimental claim (Claim 5) is only partially reproduced on a proxy pipeline with insufficient statistical power and configuration sensitivity, correctly flagged as toy.
